faq: No one can. We fix the things within our control, such as speed, titles and structure, and set you up so search engines can read your store clearly. Rankings depend on many other factors.
Will removing apps break my store?
We list every app and script first, and only remove those that are unused or duplicated. We test the pages before and after, and keep a backup of the theme.
Do you write all my product descriptions?
We fix titles, meta descriptions and headings. Full product description writing is separate. For key pages we suggest wording you can approve first.
Do you need access to Search Console?
Read access helps us find real problems. If you do not have it set up, we can verify your store and connect it as part of the work.
